landing.title: English for developers, with a clear path from A2 to B2.
landing.subtitle: Standups, code reviews, bug reports, emails, interviews, and explaining technical ideas in English. About 15 minutes a day, one focused unit at a time.
landing.free: Free. No account needed to start.
landing.pathBody: Each stage mixes workplace situations with technical knowledge in English and ends with a checkpoint and a certificate.

words.title: Words & patterns
words.body: IT vocabulary with pronunciation, Vietnamese meanings and real examples; patterns explained briefly in Vietnamese.

talk.title: Talk to colleagues
talk.body: Linh, Tuấn, Sarah, Raj… each leads a situation. Pick your reply and get feedback on how it sounds.

task.title: Real tasks
task.body: Write a Slack message, a bug report or a PR description, or say your standup. AI grades it and shows a better version.

review.title: Review at the right time
review.body: Words come back just before you'd forget them (FSRS), always with a real check.
